sourceFile: 13. TIU C11-20 Result test Frame load tray 2025.12.18_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable test-result evidence but misclassifies repeated trials as baseline/test changed conditions.
issues: No explicit baseline or normal condition is cited.
Time 1-7 are repeated runs, not changed factors.
Changed factor should be improved test jig/frame load tray.
Metric header row is not cited in case evidence.
Judgement cannot compare improvement without prior baseline data.
correctionPlan: Recast as single-condition validation of improved test jig/frame load tray.
Set baselineCondition to not provided rather than a comparator.
Move Time 1-7 and Total into subgroup or subResults only.
Limit judgement to observed pickup NG rate unless baseline evidence is added.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but header and changed-factor support need correction before final use.
